senses.definition: A mother or father; a living thing that produces young; or a company that owns another company.
senses.example: Each parent received a copy of the school report.

senses.definition: To care for and guide a child as a mother or father.
senses.example: They try to parent with patience and clear rules.

senses.definition: To end an action, prevent something, bring a vehicle to rest, or block an opening.
senses.example: Please stop talking while she explains the rules.

senses.definition: An end or pause in movement or activity, or a place where a bus or train lets people get on and off.
senses.example: The bus stop is beside the library.

senses.definition: The front of a head, an expression, the front or surface of something, or a person's public respect.
senses.example: She had a big smile on her face.

senses.zh: 面对；面向；正视；覆盖表面
senses.definition: To look toward something, deal with a problem, or cover the front of a building with a material.
senses.example: The room faces the garden.

senses.zh: 任何事物；某事物（疑问或否定句）
senses.definition: Any thing at all, or a thing of any kind in questions and negative statements.
senses.example: Is there anything you need from the shop?

senses.definition: To make something new or cause a situation to exist.
senses.example: The children created a story about a lost dog.

senses.zh: 公众的；公共的；公开的；政府的
senses.definition: For everyone to use or know about, or connected with people in general or the government.
senses.example: The council opened a new public library.

senses.definition: People in general, or the people interested in a particular activity.
senses.example: The garden is open to the public every weekend.

senses.definition: Before now or before a stated time, sometimes earlier than expected.
senses.example: I have already packed my bag.

senses.zh: 说话；讲某种语言；发言；表明
senses.definition: To use your voice to say words, use a language, give a talk, or express an opinion or message.
senses.example: Can you speak a little more slowly?

senses.zh: 其他的人或事物；其余的人或事物
senses.definition: People or things apart from those already mentioned.
senses.example: Some seats are empty, but others are taken.

author: vocab_author_a

senses.zh: 阅读；读出；理解；显示；读数
senses.definition: To get meaning from written words, say them aloud, understand signs, or show or check a measurement.
senses.example: I read a few pages before bed every night.

senses.zh: 阅读；读物；理解或判断（非正式）
senses.definition: A period of reading, something worth reading, or someone's understanding of a situation.
senses.example: This short novel is a great read.

notes: 原形和现在时 read 读 /riːd/；过去式及过去分词 read 读 /red/，拼写不变。名词读 /riːd/。

senses.zh: 水平；高度；数量程度；楼层；水平仪
senses.definition: A height, amount, standard, or floor of a building; also a tool for checking whether a surface is flat.
senses.example: The water level rose after the rain.

senses.zh: 平的；同高的；平稳的；比分相同的
senses.definition: Flat and not sloping, at the same height or score, or steady and calm.
senses.example: Keep the shelf level while I tighten the screws.

senses.zh: 弄平；夷平；使相等；指向；直说
senses.definition: To make flat or equal, destroy a building, aim something, or speak honestly when used with with.
senses.example: The workers levelled the ground for the new path.

senses.zh: 允许；给予；留出；承认；考虑到
senses.definition: To let something happen, give or set aside time or money, or accept or take account of a fact.
senses.example: Allow ten minutes to walk to the station.

senses.definition: To put something with what is already there, total numbers, or say an extra point.
senses.example: Add the onions and cook for two minutes.

senses.zh: 办公室；办事处；事务所；公职；职务
senses.definition: A place for desk work or services, or an official position with duties.
senses.example: Her office is on the third floor.

senses.definition: To use money, time, or energy for something.
senses.example: We spent the afternoon walking beside the river.

senses.zh: 花费；支出额（尤商业用语）
senses.definition: The amount of money used for a particular purpose.
senses.example: The team reduced its advertising spend this year.

senses.definition: A part that opens and closes an entrance, the entrance itself, or a possible way to achieve something.
senses.example: Please close the door to keep the room warm.

senses.zh: 健康；健康状况；运行状况
senses.definition: The condition of a person's body and mind, or how well an organization or system is doing.
senses.example: Regular walks are good for your health.

senses.definition: A human being, someone's body or presence, or a grammar form showing who speaks or is spoken about.
senses.example: Only one person can use the lift at a time.

senses.zh: 艺术；艺术作品；技艺；人文学科
senses.definition: Creative work such as painting or music, the things made this way, a learned skill, or subjects such as literature.
senses.example: The children enjoyed making art from old boxes.

senses.definition: Having no doubt, certain to happen, or able to be trusted.
senses.example: Are you sure this is the right address?

senses.definition: Used to agree readily or strongly say that something is true.
senses.example: It sure feels warmer in here.

senses.definition: Armed fighting between countries or groups, or a determined fight against a serious problem.
senses.example: The families left the city because of the war.

senses.definition: To fight against another group, country, or force.
senses.example: The two groups had warred over the land for years.

senses.zh: 历史；历史学；过去经历；记录
senses.definition: Events of the past, the study of them, or a record of what happened to a person or thing.
senses.example: The doctor asked about my medical history.

senses.definition: A social celebration, a political organization, a person or side in an agreement, or a group travelling together.
senses.example: We invited our neighbours to the birthday party.

senses.definition: To enjoy yourself at a social celebration, often with music and dancing.
senses.example: They partied until midnight after the final exam.

senses.definition: Inside a place, period, group, or limit.
senses.example: Please reply within three days.

senses.definition: Inside a place, organization, or person.
senses.example: The company decided to promote someone from within.

senses.zh: 生长；增长；种植；逐渐变得；培育
senses.definition: To become bigger or change gradually, or help plants, a business, or another thing develop.
senses.example: We grow tomatoes in pots on the balcony.

senses.zh: 结果；成绩；比赛结果；计算答案
senses.definition: Something caused by an action, or a score or answer from a test, match, or calculation.
senses.example: The results of the test will arrive tomorrow.

senses.definition: To happen because of something, or lead to an outcome.
senses.example: The heavy rain resulted in several road closures.

senses.zh: 打开的；营业的；开放的；坦率的；未定的
senses.definition: Not closed or blocked; available to use; willing to discuss or accept ideas; or not yet decided.
senses.example: The shop is open until eight tonight.

senses.definition: To make something no longer closed, or begin a business, event, or opportunity.
senses.example: Could you open the window a little?

senses.definition: An outdoor place, a state of being publicly known, or a sports contest that allows both amateurs and professionals.
senses.example: We ate our lunch out in the open.

senses.definition: The part of a day from midnight or sunrise until noon.
senses.example: I usually go for a walk in the morning.

senses.definition: To move on foot, accompany someone on foot, exercise a dog, or let a batter reach first base on balls.
senses.example: I walk to work when the weather is fine.

senses.zh: 步行；散步；步行路线；步态；保送
senses.definition: A journey on foot, a walking route or way of walking, or a free move to first base in baseball.
senses.example: Let's go for a short walk after dinner.

senses.definition: A cause or explanation for something, or the ability to think clearly and make sensible judgments.
senses.example: What was the reason for the delay?

senses.definition: To reach a conclusion by thinking carefully, or try to persuade someone using clear arguments.
senses.example: We tried to reason with him, but he would not listen.

senses.zh: 低的；少的；低沉的；消沉的；不足的
senses.definition: Not high or large, quiet or deep in sound, sad, or having little left.
senses.example: The water in the lake is very low this summer.

senses.definition: At or to a small height, in a quiet or deep voice, or at a small price.
senses.example: The birds flew low over the water.

senses.definition: A small recorded amount, a period of poor mood or success, or an area of low air pressure.
senses.example: The temperature fell to a new low last night.

author: vocab_author_a

senses.zh: 节目；计划；课程；节目单；机器运行程序
senses.definition: A broadcast, a planned set of activities or studies, a printed event guide, or a series of machine actions.
senses.example: The programme on the radio was about life at sea.

senses.zh: 安排；规划；设置机器步骤；使形成固定行为
senses.definition: To plan activities, set a machine's actions, or make a person or animal behave in a fixed way without thinking.
senses.example: The museum has programmed several talks for the autumn.

notes: 英式 programme 用于节目、活动计划等；计算机程序通常英美都写 program。机器的洗涤等运行程序可写 programme。

senses.definition: To do best in a contest, receive a prize, or gain something through effort.
senses.example: Our team won the match by one point.

senses.definition: A victory in a contest or a successful outcome.
senses.example: The team celebrated its first win of the season.

senses.definition: Careful study to discover facts or understand something better.
senses.example: She is doing research into how children learn to read.

senses.definition: To study a subject carefully and collect information about it.
senses.example: We researched the area before choosing a hotel.

author: vocab_author_a

senses.definition: A female child or young woman.
senses.example: The girl in the red coat is my cousin.

notes: 称成年女性 girl 可能显得不够尊重；正式或不熟悉的关系中用 woman。

author: vocab_author_a

senses.definition: A man in informal speech; in the plural, a group of people; or a rope holding a tent or pole steady.
senses.example: The guy at the next table offered to help.

notes: you guys 在非正式交流中可称呼一群人，不限全是男性；正式场合可用 everyone。拉索义与男人义是不同来源的同形词。

senses.definition: Near the beginning of a period or happening before the usual or expected time.
senses.example: We caught an early train to avoid the crowds.

senses.definition: Near the beginning of a period or before the expected time.
senses.example: Please arrive ten minutes early.

senses.definition: Things eaten to live and grow; in food for thought, ideas worth thinking about.
senses.example: We brought enough food for the whole trip.

senses.definition: The same male person as the subject, or a word that stresses that he acts personally or alone.
senses.example: He made the shelves himself.

senses.zh: 片刻；时刻；时机；重要性（正式）；力矩
senses.definition: A very short time, a particular time or opportunity, importance, or the turning effect of a force.
senses.example: Wait a moment while I find my keys.

senses.zh: 空气；空中；神态；曲调；架子
senses.definition: The mixture of gases we breathe, the space above the ground, a manner or impression, a tune, or a show of importance.
senses.example: Open the window and let in some fresh air.

senses.definition: To let fresh air reach something, express a view publicly, or broadcast a programme.
senses.example: The meeting gave everyone a chance to air their concerns.

senses.definition: A person who helps others learn, especially as a job in a school.
senses.example: My teacher showed me another way to solve the problem.

senses.zh: 力量；武力；影响力；部队；警力
senses.definition: Physical strength, power to cause change, violent action, or a group trained for military or police work.
senses.example: The force of the wind broke a large branch.

senses.zh: 强迫；迫使；用力推动；强行取得
senses.definition: To make someone act against their wishes, cause something to happen, or move or open something with strength.
senses.example: Heavy rain forced us to cancel the picnic.

senses.zh: 提供；提议；出价；主动愿意做
senses.definition: To make something available, suggest an action or price, or say you are willing to help.
senses.example: She offered to drive us to the station.

senses.definition: A suggestion, a price proposed, something made available, or a reduced-price deal.
senses.example: I accepted the offer of a new job.

author: vocab_author_a

senses.definition: As much or as many as needed, used with a noun.
senses.example: We have enough chairs for all the guests.

senses.definition: An amount that meets a need; also used to say that no more is wanted.
senses.example: There is enough for everyone.

senses.definition: To the degree needed, or to a fairly good degree.
senses.example: The bag is large enough for my books.

数量代指用法按本词库现代语法体系改列 pron.，含义保留；并非认定所有词典的名词分析错误。

senses.zh: 教育；受教育经历；教育学
senses.definition: The process of teaching and learning, the knowledge gained, or the study of how people are taught.
senses.example: Every child deserves a good education.

senses.definition: From one side to another, on the opposite side, or in many parts of a place or group.
senses.example: We walked across the bridge together.

senses.zh: 从一边到另一边；在对面；横向
senses.definition: From one side to another or on the other side, often describing width or movement.
senses.example: The river is too wide to swim across.

senses.definition: Used to link facts that contrast or make each other surprising.
senses.example: Although it was raining, we still enjoyed the walk.

senses.zh: 记得；想起；记住去做；纪念；代问候
senses.definition: To bring a fact to mind, not forget an action, keep someone's memory alive, or send greetings through another person.
senses.example: Remember to take your keys when you leave.

author: vocab_author_a

senses.definition: The part of the body you stand on, the bottom of something, a length of 12 inches, or a unit of rhythm in poetry.
senses.example: We rested at the foot of the hill.

senses.zh: 支付账单（用于 foot the bill）
senses.definition: To pay a bill, especially a large one or one for other people.
senses.example: The company will foot the bill for the repairs.

notes: 动词优先展示现代常见 foot the bill 支付；不把旧词典罕见的给鞋换底放入首屏。

author: vocab_author_a

senses.zh: 秒；片刻；第二名；添的一份；次品
senses.definition: One of 60 equal parts of a minute, a brief time, the place after first, an extra helping of food, or an item with a small fault.
senses.example: The light changed after thirty seconds.

senses.zh: 第二的；另一个的；次要的
senses.definition: After the first in order or importance, or another of the same kind.
senses.example: This is my second visit to the city.

senses.definition: In the next position after first, or introducing the next point in a list.
senses.example: She finished second in the race.

senses.definition: To formally support a suggestion, or temporarily send someone to work in another team or organization.
senses.example: I second your proposal to start the meeting earlier.

notes: 秒、第二及附议通常读 /ˈsekənd/；英式动词“借调”通常读 /sɪˈkɒnd/。seconds 可指添的一份食物或次品。

evidence.note: 本轮访问核对副词、附议动词、英式借调及其不同重音；释义例句为自主编写。

senses.zh: 男孩；少年；儿子；男伴们（非正式）
senses.definition: A male child or young person; also someone's son or a male friend in informal speech.
senses.example: The boy waited outside the classroom with his sister.

senses.definition: Used when something is possible but you are not certain, or when making a gentle suggestion.
senses.example: Maybe we could take the train instead.

senses.definition: An uncertain answer or a possible thing that has not been decided.
senses.example: She gave me a maybe rather than a definite yes.

author: vocab_author_a

senses.zh: 朝；接近；对于；用于；有助于
senses.definition: In the direction of, close to a time or amount, in relation to someone, or helping to pay for or achieve something.
senses.example: She walked toward the open door.

notes: toward 与 towards 词义相同；toward 在美式英语更常见，towards 在英式英语更常见。

senses.zh: 能够的；能干的；有能力的
senses.definition: Having the power, skill, or chance to do something, or being good at a task.
senses.example: Will you be able to join us tomorrow?

senses.zh: 年龄；时代；很长时间；老年
senses.definition: How long someone or something has existed, a period of history, a very long time, or the later years of life.
senses.example: Children of the same age can develop at different speeds.

senses.definition: To become older, make someone seem older, or develop the taste of food or drink over time.
senses.example: The cheese is aged for six months before it is sold.

senses.definition: A planned way of making decisions or acting, a personal rule, or a written insurance agreement.
senses.example: The school has a clear policy on mobile phones.

senses.zh: 所有事物；一切；最重要的事物
senses.definition: All the things in a situation, or what matters most to someone.
senses.example: Have you packed everything you need?

senses.zh: 爱；爱情；喜爱；心爱的人；零分（网球）
senses.definition: Deep care or affection, strong enjoyment, a person you care for, or a score of zero in tennis.
senses.example: Her love of music began when she was very young.

senses.definition: To care deeply for someone, greatly enjoy something, or very much want to do it.
senses.example: I love spending quiet evenings with my family.

senses.zh: 过程；程序；工序；法律程序
senses.definition: A series of actions or changes leading to a result, including steps used in law, making goods, or running software.
senses.example: Learning to drive is a gradual process.

senses.zh: 处理；加工；办理；理解消化
senses.definition: To deal with information or requests, change materials into products, or take time to understand an experience.
senses.example: The office will process your application within a week.

senses.definition: Sounds arranged to create rhythm or a tune, pieces made this way, or written signs showing how to play them.
senses.example: Soft music was playing in the café.

senses.definition: Used to name something as part of a larger group or total.
senses.example: Six people came to dinner, including my parents.

senses.zh: 考虑；认为；体谅；把…纳入考虑
senses.definition: To think carefully about something, hold an opinion, or take account of someone's needs or a relevant fact.
senses.example: We are considering moving closer to the school.

senses.zh: 出现；显得；发表；出演；出庭
senses.definition: To become visible, seem to be something, be published, or take part in a performance or court case.
senses.example: A small boat appeared through the mist.

senses.definition: Used to give the real facts, correct an idea, or express surprise that something really happens.
senses.example: I thought the shop was closed, but it is actually open.

senses.zh: 购买；换取；收买；相信（非正式）
senses.definition: To get something by paying, gain an advantage with money, bribe someone, or accept a story as true.
senses.example: We bought fresh bread on the way home.

senses.zh: 买到的东西；划算的交易
senses.definition: Something purchased, especially when judging whether it was worth the price.
senses.example: These comfortable shoes were a very good buy.

senses.definition: Used when you think something is likely to be true or happen, but are not completely certain.
senses.example: The train will probably arrive a few minutes late.

senses.zh: 人的；人类的；有人性的；难免犯错的
senses.definition: Related to people, or showing the feelings, needs, and weaknesses that people naturally have.
senses.example: Everyone makes mistakes; we are all human.

senses.definition: A person, rather than an animal or machine.
senses.example: The animals had rarely seen humans before.

senses.zh: 等待；等候；延缓；服侍（用于短语）
senses.definition: To stay until something happens, leave something until later, or serve people food when used with on or at tables.
senses.example: I'll wait here while you buy the tickets.

senses.definition: A period spent staying until something happens.
senses.example: We had a long wait at the airport.

senses.zh: 服务；供应；担任；适用；服刑；发球
senses.definition: To help or work for others, give food, do a duty, be useful, spend time in prison, or start a point in a racket sport.
senses.example: This café serves breakfast until eleven.

senses.definition: The action that starts a point in a sport such as tennis by hitting the ball to the other player.
senses.example: Her first serve landed outside the line.

senses.zh: 市场；集市；需求；买方群体
senses.definition: A place or system for buying and selling, or the people who want a particular product.
senses.example: We buy fresh vegetables at the Saturday market.

senses.definition: To offer or promote a product so that people will buy it.
senses.example: The company markets its bags as light and durable.

senses.zh: 死亡；枯萎；消失；熄灭；停止工作
senses.definition: To stop living, become weaker until gone, or stop working or burning.
senses.example: My phone died before I could send the message.

senses.definition: One small numbered object used in games, a tool that shapes or cuts material, or a bare piece of a computer chip.
senses.example: Roll the die and move your piece along the board.

senses.zh: 发送；寄；派遣；使进入某状态
senses.definition: To cause something or someone to go somewhere, or make a person enter a particular state.
senses.example: Please send me the address by email.

senses.zh: 预料；期待；要求；等待到来；怀孕
senses.definition: To think something will happen, believe someone should do something, wait for an arrival, or be pregnant.
senses.example: We expect the parcel to arrive tomorrow.

senses.zh: 感官；感觉；意识；道理；意义
senses.definition: An ability such as sight, a feeling or awareness, good judgment, or the meaning of words.
senses.example: That explanation makes sense to me.

senses.definition: To notice something without being told, or detect it with a device.
senses.example: I sensed that she wanted to leave.

senses.definition: To make a structure, develop something over time, or become stronger or larger.
senses.example: We are building a small shed in the garden.

senses.zh: 体格；构建版本；制造方式
senses.definition: The shape and strength of someone's body, a version of software, or how something is constructed.
senses.example: He has a strong build from years of swimming.

senses.zh: 停留；暂住；保持；暂停（法律）
senses.definition: To remain in a place or state, live somewhere briefly, or officially delay an action.
senses.example: We stayed with my sister for the weekend.

senses.zh: 停留；暂住；暂停执行；支撑物
senses.definition: A period spent in a place, an official delay, or a support that holds something firmly.
senses.example: Thank you for making our stay so comfortable.

senses.zh: 落下；跌倒；下降；陷入；发生在；失守
senses.definition: To move down, lose balance, become less, enter a state, happen at a time, or lose power or control.
senses.example: The temperature will fall below zero tonight.

senses.zh: 跌倒；下降；倒台；秋季；瀑布（复数）
senses.definition: A drop or decrease, a loss of power, autumn in American English, or water dropping over a steep edge in a river.
senses.example: She hurt her wrist in a fall on the stairs.

senses.definition: A sound used to show surprise, understanding, disappointment, or a sudden thought.
senses.example: Oh, I left my keys on the kitchen table!

senses.definition: A country and its people, or a large group sharing a history, culture, or identity.
senses.example: People from many nations took part in the festival.

senses.definition: An intended set of actions, an idea about what to do, or a drawing showing a building or layout.
senses.example: Our plan is to leave before the roads get busy.

senses.definition: To decide in advance what to do or how something will be arranged or built.
senses.example: We plan to visit the museum on Saturday.

senses.zh: 切；割；剪；削减；停止；删去；逃课
senses.definition: To divide or wound with something sharp, make less, stop a supply, leave something out, or skip a class.
senses.example: We need to cut our spending this month.

senses.zh: 切口；伤口；削减；份额；剪裁；剪辑版
senses.definition: A wound or opening, a reduction, a share of money, the shape of clothing, or a version of an edited film.
senses.example: The workers opposed the proposed pay cut.

senses.zh: 切开的；剪下的；有伤口的
senses.definition: Separated with a sharp tool or having a wound made by one.
senses.example: She put the cut flowers in a vase.

senses.zh: 学院；大学；职业学校；学会
senses.definition: A place of education after or alongside secondary school, a part of a university, or a professional organization.
senses.example: She is studying engineering at college.

senses.zh: 兴趣；爱好；利息；利益；权益
senses.definition: A wish to know more, an activity you enjoy, money paid for borrowing or saving, or a benefit or share in something.
senses.example: The account pays interest on your savings.

senses.definition: To make someone want to know more or become involved.
senses.example: Would a course in photography interest you?

senses.definition: The end of a life, or the complete end of something.
senses.example: The family gathered after their grandmother's death.

senses.zh: 课程；路线；进程；一道菜；疗程；场地
senses.definition: A set of lessons, a route or development, one part of a meal, a series of treatments, or a sports ground.
senses.example: The meal included three courses.

senses.definition: To flow or move quickly through or across something.
senses.example: Water coursed down the street after the storm.

senses.definition: A person whose name or identity is not stated or known.
senses.example: Someone has left a scarf on the chair.

senses.definition: Knowledge gained by doing things, or an event that you live through.
senses.example: She has years of experience teaching young children.

senses.definition: To have something happen to you or feel something yourself.
senses.example: We experienced a short power cut last night.

senses.zh: 在…后面；落后于；支持；是…原因
senses.definition: At the back of, less advanced than, supporting, or responsible for something.
senses.example: The garden is behind the house.

senses.definition: At the back, remaining in a place, or not keeping up.
senses.example: I waited for the children who had fallen behind.

senses.definition: A person's bottom, used as a mild or polite expression.
senses.example: The toddler landed on his behind and laughed.

senses.zh: 到达；达到；伸手够到；联系上；影响到
senses.definition: To arrive at a place or goal, stretch to touch something, contact someone, or have an effect on people.
senses.example: Can you reach the cup on the top shelf?

senses.zh: 触及范围；影响范围；河段
senses.definition: The distance you can stretch or have an effect over, or a section of a river.
senses.example: Keep the medicine out of children's reach.

senses.definition: Connected with a nearby area or limited to one part of a body or thing.
senses.example: We bought fruit at the local shop.

senses.zh: 本地人；附近酒吧（英式）；慢车
senses.definition: A person living nearby, a pub someone regularly visits, or a train that stops at many stations.
senses.example: A local showed us the shortest route to the beach.

senses.definition: The number after five and before seven.
senses.example: There are six eggs left in the box.

senses.zh: 数字6；六点的牌或骰子；六分球（板球）
senses.definition: The written number 6, a card or die showing it, or a cricket hit that scores six runs.
senses.example: She rolled a six and moved to the final square.

author: vocab_author_a

senses.zh: 杀死；扼杀；终止；消磨；使极痛或疲惫
senses.definition: To cause death, stop something completely, pass time, or cause great pain or tiredness in informal speech.
senses.example: We read magazines to kill time before the appointment.

senses.zh: 猎杀；被杀的猎物；致命一击
senses.definition: An act of killing, an animal killed by a hunter or predator, or the final action that ends a contest.
senses.example: The lions returned to their kill.

notes: 删除同一名词行误并入的“小河”：该义主要是荷兰语来源的特定地名成分，不适合此现代常用动词卡。猎杀/猎物的名词保留。

author: vocab_author_a

senses.definition: To continue to be somewhere or in a state, be left over, or still need to be done.
senses.example: Please remain seated until the train stops.

senses.zh: 遗迹；残余；遗体（通常用 remains）
senses.definition: Things left after other parts are gone, or the body of a person or animal after death; usually in the plural.
senses.example: We visited the remains of an old castle.

notes: 名词常用复数 remains，表示残存物、遗迹或遗体，不应把裸词 remain 当普通单数遗体使用。

senses.zh: 影响；效果；作用；特效；财物（复数）
senses.definition: A change caused by something, an impression or created sound or image, or belongings when used in the plural.
senses.example: The medicine had little effect on the pain.

senses.definition: To bring about a change or achieve a result.
senses.example: The new rules effected a major change in how the team worked.

senses.definition: An informal way to agree or say yes.
senses.example: Yeah, that time works for me.

senses.zh: 建议；提议；暗示；使联想到
senses.definition: To put forward an idea, show that something may be true, or bring a thought to mind.
senses.example: I suggest taking a short break before we continue.

senses.zh: 班级；课；阶层；类别；等级；风度
senses.definition: A group of students or a lesson, a social group or category, a level of quality, or stylish behaviour.
senses.example: Our class is learning about plants this week.

senses.definition: To place someone or something in a category.
senses.example: These animals are classed as endangered.

senses.definition: Very good or showing a high standard, especially in informal praise.
senses.example: That was a class performance from the young goalkeeper.

evidence.note: 本轮官方搜索内容核对 class 为非正式的优质形容词，通常置于名词前。

senses.zh: 控制；管理；克制；操纵装置；对照组
senses.definition: The power to direct things, restraint, a device used to operate something, or a comparison group in a test.
senses.example: She stayed calm and kept control of the situation.

senses.definition: To direct how something works, manage a situation, or limit an unwanted action or amount.
senses.example: Use this button to control the volume.

senses.zh: 举起；提高；筹集；抚养；提出；引起
senses.definition: To lift or increase, collect money, bring up a child or animal, introduce a topic, or cause a feeling.
senses.example: The school raised money for new library books.

senses.definition: An increase in pay, especially in American English, or a higher bet in a card game.
senses.example: She received a raise after taking on more responsibility.
